question: I want to identify the peak day of abnormally large planned LNG vessel arrivals within the window of January 1 to 7, 2020, and see which dates are significantly higher than the normal level of the previous week.

    SELECT
        DATE(t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME) AS arrival_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_cnt
    FROM ng_future_lng_shipping_schedule t
    WHERE t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME >= '2019-12-25'
      AND t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME < '2020-01-08'
      AND (t.DEL_FLAG IS NULL OR t.DEL_FLAG <> 1)
    GROUP BY DATE(t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME)
), baseline AS (
    SELECT
        d.arrival_date,
        d.daily_cnt,
        AVG(d.daily_cnt) OVER (
            ORDER BY d.arrival_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prev_7d_avg,
        SUM(d.daily_cnt) OVER (
            ORDER BY d.arrival_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prev_7d_sum
    FROM daily_cnt d
)
SELECT
    b.arrival_date,
    b.daily_cnt,
    ROUND(b.prev_7d_avg, 2) AS prev_7d_avg,
    ROUND(b.daily_cnt - b.prev_7d_avg, 2) AS excess_cnt,
    ROUND(b.daily_cnt / NULLIF(b.prev_7d_avg, 0), 2) AS spike_ratio
FROM baseline b
WHERE b.arrival_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-07'
ORDER BY spike_ratio DESC, excess_cnt DESC, b.arrival_date
